content.html:
• Busy busy busy.
  • My dentist’s uncanny mind-reading ability has struck again, and now that my teeth are fixed I have been successfully upsold on a new treatment.
  • My dermatologist finally let me graduate the big-boy skincare medication. How do I feel? Well, relieved: Six months of dry lips & skin and mood-swings were unpleasant. However it worked including strangely for my hair. I’m gonna remain on a (very) low dose.
  • Sitting in the park in Osaki is very good. Why don’t we sit in more parks?
  • Leadership training programme concluded this week. I still see room for growth in me, but I learned a lot and walk away with new connections, and new ways of thinking about motivation, growth & emotional wellbeing.
  • Team Kato!!!
  • Team drinks on Thursday were super fun and reminiscent of team nights in 2018. いい感じだったと思う.
  • Spent Friday and Saturday with visiting friends, in-between Ginza, Akasaka, Yoyogi and Omotesando. Discovered some new bars, some new coffee shops and talked a lot about eastern european food. And a bit about cows.
  • Sunday we had lunch at a new Russian restaurant (I approve) before breaking in a serious new contender for Yotsuya’s best coffee.
  • Then went to the Meet Your Art Festival to take a lot of photos, speak to a few artists and to have a genuinely profound and surreal experience in an audio-only exhibit.
  • Whenever an artist tried to sell me something, I said “I’m looking for something specific, I’ll know it when I see it”
